entries.clue: Purple autumn flower whose three red stigmas are hand-picked and dried for saffron
Dried unopened flower bud, nail-shaped, stuck into a baked ham or an orange
Great glass lift that bursts through a roof and climbs into orbit
Adjective the title bestows on Mr Fox, raider of a hidden cider cellar
Cloudy homemade citrus drink, sold warm by the plastic cup on a hot afternoon
Cocoa sweet, churned by waterfall, that runs as a river through the factory
Green three-sided case of black seeds, bruised into rice and Scandinavian buns
Big hired tent with a peaked roof, up on Friday and dripping by Saturday
Hot brown brew poured from a big metal urn in the refreshment tent, milk already in it
Patricia ___, the actress wife Dahl drilled back to speech after strokes
Home-baked bread entered in its own class and judged on crust and crumb
Thick bowl of stone or marble that takes the pounding; also a bricklayer's mix
